cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Freelance Copywriter position at Coalition Technologies. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I've built my career at the intersection of SEO, content, and web—writing copy that not only engages readers but also ranks and drives measurable results. Your focus on SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites aligns perfectly with my experience.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites. I've written and published blog posts, product descriptions, and category pages for an e-commerce site (proteinbox.com.tr) and two Shopify stores (harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com). I also manage CMS content in WordPress, ensuring consistency and accuracy across pages. Previously, as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I built WordPress sites and ran SEO analyses, giving me a deep understanding of how content and technical SEO work together.

Beyond client work, I've built and optimized my own sites, including mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits. This hands-on experience taught me to research unfamiliar industries quickly and adapt to different brand voices—skills I know are essential for your diverse client base.

I'm fluent in English and confident in my ability to follow detailed guidelines, meet deadlines, and communicate professionally. I'd love the opportunity to bring my SEO writing expertise to your team and contribute to high-quality, conversion-focused content.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of working together.

Sincerely,
